WITH overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_avg_hgb 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
patient_avgs AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg_hgb 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY ID
),
above_average_patients AS (
    SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_avg_hgb, oa.overall_avg_hgb
    FROM patient_avgs pa
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
    WHERE pa.patient_avg_hgb > oa.overall_avg_hgb
),
avg_of_above_avg_patients AS (
    SELECT AVG(patient_avg_hgb) as avg_above_avg
    FROM above_average_patients
)
SELECT 
    aap.ID,
    aap.patient_avg_hgb,
    aap.patient_avg_hgb - aap.overall_avg_hgb as above_overall_avg,
    aap.patient_avg_hgb - aabp.avg_above_avg as diff_from_above_avg_mean
FROM above_average_patients aap
CROSS JOIN avg_of_above_avg_patients aabp
ORDER BY diff_from_above_avg_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: NULL HGB values are excluded from all average calculations (standard SQL AVG() behavior), so only non-null records contribute
